items.title: 23.9 Acyl, alkyl aur aryl chlorides ki hydrolysis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu comparison of the hydrolysis of acyl, alkyl and aryl chlorides (PDF 114-115).

blocks.text: Acyl chlorides, alkyl chlorides aur aryl chlorides ki reactivity ka muqabla is se ho sakta hai ke yeh kitni aasani se hydrolyse hote hain:

items: Ethanoyl chloride kamre ke darja hararat par paani se tezi se react karta hai: CH3COCl + H2O -> CH3COOH + HCl. Is ke carbonyl carbon par bara juzwi musbat charge hai, kyunke do bohat electronegative atoms, oxygen aur chlorine, seedhe us se jure hain, is liye paani itni tezi se hamla karta hai ke reaction chand minute mein mukammal ho jata hai.

Chloroethane sirf reflux par garam karne se hydrolyse hota hai: CH3CH2Cl + H2O -> CH3CH2OH + HCl. Is ka carbon sirf aik electronegative atom, chlorine, se jura hai, is liye kam musbat hai aur paani kaheen aahista hamla karta hai; kitab kehti hai ke 100 C par bhi reaction 14 din leta hai.

Chlorobenzene paani se react nahi karta. Chlorine se jura carbon benzene ring ka hissa hai, aur chlorine ka lone pair ring ke pi electrons ke saath delocalised hota hai, jis se C-Cl bond mein kuch double bond ki khasiyat aati hai; bond itna mazboot hai ke nahi toot'ta.

blocks.alt: Paani ke saath teen reactions. Ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + H2O, 'Room temperature, rapid', se ethanoic acid + HCl. Chloroethane, CH3-CH2-Cl, + H2O, 'Heat under reflux', se ethanol + HCl. Chlorobenzene + H2O: No Reaction.
blocks.caption: Ethanoyl chloride, chloroethane aur chlorobenzene ki hydrolysis (kitab ke PDF safha 114 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Phenols carboxylic acids se seedhe react kar ke phenyl esters kyun nahi banate?
blocks.explanation: Phenol ke oxygen ka lone pair ring mein delocalised hai, is liye phenol kamzor nucleophile hai aur kamzor electrophilic carboxylic acid se mufeed taur par react nahi karta; is ki jagah zyada reactive acyl chloride use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethanoyl chloride aur phenol se phenyl ethanoate banane ka mua'adla likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH3COCl + C6H5OH -> CH3COOC6H5 + HCl (garam; NaOH jaisa base phenoxide ion bana kar madad deta hai).

blocks.prompt: Products batayein: (i) chlorobenzene aur ethanol; (ii) propanoyl chloride aur phenol.
blocks.explanation: (i) Koi reaction nahi: chlorobenzene ka C-Cl bond bohat mazboot hai. (ii) CH3CH2COCl + C6H5OH -> CH3CH2COOC6H5 + HCl (phenyl propanoate).

items: Ethanoyl chloride: kamre ke darje par tez hydrolysis (C par O aur Cl).
Chloroethane: aahista, reflux chahiye; chlorobenzene: koi reaction nahi (Cl ka delocalised lone pair).
Acyl chloride > alkyl chloride > aryl chloride.
